name: visual-consistency-audit
description: Evidence-driven visual and navigation consistency auditing for application UIs.

interface.shortDescription: Audit visual and navigation drift with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Audits application UIs for visual drift, accessibility defects, responsive inconsistencies, and broken cross-page navigation continuity, then produces an evidence-backed semantic contract and remediation plan.
defaultPrompt: Audit this app for visual and navigation consistency.
Create an evidence-backed visual consistency fix plan.
Verify this UI against its semantic visual contract.
